decisions.diagnosis: Counter 231 reported 'good' zeros in every slot of a Sunday in both directions while riders passed (days either side are normal), so the true counts were never recorded and cannot be recovered.
Counter 231 failed and reported 'good' zeros in both directions for 16 months on a busy commuter cycleway; nothing was counted so the period cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Normal days to 2014-12-11 (443/441); every slot 0 from 2014-12-11 23:30 to 2016-04-30 13:30; counts resume Saturday afternoon 2016-04-30 and 848/847 on Monday 2016-05-02.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 231 failed and reported 'good' zeros in both directions for ten months while neighbouring counters kept counting, so the counts cannot be recovered.
Feed outage: all records are 'warning' zeros and every nearby site is zero on the same three days, so no counts exist to recover.
decisions.evidence: 0/0 on 2023-06-30..07-02 (2304 warning records) vs 849/721 on 06-29 and 738/695 on 07-03; 545 also 0 those days only.

decisions.diagnosis: Feed outage for counter 355: a full weekday of 'warning' zeros, zero at every nearby site too, so no counts exist to recover.
On about 40 whole days counter 231's four channel records were loaded twice (8 records per slot, each an exact copy), doubling those days' totals.
decisions.evidence: duplicates(): every slot matched on each flagged day (e.g. 2024-03-24/25 192/192 slots, +1809 bikes on 322); those days have 0 odd slots and daily totals ~2x neighbours (322: 1618, 2000 vs ~1000-1100); records_per_slot 8.0 vs 4.0.

series.name: Northbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Same site, both piezo, no overlap (231 ends 2025-04-14, 355 starts 2025-10-11); 322 and 1747 both citybound with the same AM-peak profile (8am 174 vs 192/h, 5pm 76 vs 85/h) and the same share of the site (~54%); the ~45% year-on-year rise Dec-Jan matches the continuous Moore Park Rd tube (168: +37%/+45%), so the new counter reads comparably.

series.name: Southbound (outbound)
series.evidence: 323 and 1748 both non-citybound with the same PM-peak profile (5pm 151 vs 166/h, 8am 51 vs 55/h); direction ratio 322/323 ~1.19 before and 1747/1748 ~1.18 after; level change matches area-wide growth at the independent site 168.

useful: overview: month grid made the two long zero outages and the months with records_per_slot > 4 obvious at once
duplicates/doubled: pinpointed every duplicated-load day, with matched slots and repeated bikes
channels: showed each record repeated pairwise (e.g. [2,2,7,7,0,0,0,0]), confirming exact duplicates
zeros: exact start/end of the outage runs
hourly: matched directions of old and new counters by AM/PM peak
neighbours + daily/monthly on neighbour sites: separated network-wide outages and rain days from counter faults, and a continuous tube site checked counter comparability
not_useful: events: no entries for the dates in question
improve: weekly/daily: an option to return a wide table (one column per direction) would save pivots
monthly: for multi-counter sites include a per-site total column
channels: column names differ from slots (no time/count), making joins awkward
add: a multi-site daily comparison tool: daily totals for a site and its neighbours side by side, flagging days where only this site is zero
a counter-swap comparison: same-season year-on-year ratio for the site vs. nearby continuous counters

summary: Bourke St cycleway at Taylor Sq, counted by Ecocounter 231 (2013-2025) and Metrocount 355 (from Oct 2025). Counter 231 reported zeros during two long failures (Dec 2014-Apr 2016, Mar 2021-Jan 2022), plus a single dead Sunday, and there were network-wide feed outages in 2023 and 2025; all of these are set missing. About 40 days in 2022-2024 were loaded twice and need their duplicates dropped. The old and new counters' matching directions are joined into northbound and southbound series.
